title: Climate Risks, Exposure, Vulnerability and Resilience in Nepal
temporal_coverage: Assessment published in 2023; combines current risk mapping and mid-century climate projections.
methodology: Spatial hazard maps combined with socioeconomic vulnerability indicators and CMIP6 projections.
limitations: Household coping and shock outcomes are only partly captured; results are modeled.

title: Second Nationally Determined Contribution
organization: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Forests and Environment
methodology: Government submission setting out national climate vulnerability context and adaptation priorities.
limitations: The NDC is a policy statement and planned response, not an evaluation of implementation outcomes.

title: Synopsis of Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0
organization: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Forests and Environment
temporal_coverage: NDC 3.0 synopsis setting out priorities through 2035.
methodology: Four-page government synopsis of climate commitments, adaptation priorities, and estimated investment needs.
limitations: Brief synopsis rather than a full technical assessment; proposed investment needs and plans are not achieved results.

title: Enhancing Human Security through Local Climate Actions: Situational Assessment of Nalgad Municipality and Barekot Rural Municipality, Jajarkot District, Karnali Province, Nepal
temporal_coverage: Municipal baseline assessment reported in the PDF; publication date is not stated on the report cover.
methodology: Household baseline survey (824 households), consultations and assessment of municipal frameworks.
limitations: Two municipalities only; not a national estimate or armed-conflict analysis.

title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) 3.0
temporal_coverage: NDC period to 2035; loss-and-damage discussion includes 2024 events.
methodology: Government NDC submission with a national loss-and-damage account and cited event-attribution findings.
limitations: The submission does not identify its event-attribution study here; impacts are not district-disaggregated.

title: Nepal: 2024 Floods Response Plan, Humanitarian Needs and Priorities
organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator and Nepal Humanitarian Country Team
temporal_coverage: September 2024 floods and landslides; response plan for October–December 2024.
methodology: Joint Humanitarian Country Team plan using NDRRMA reporting and initial rapid assessments.
limitations: The plan says full damage estimates were still under government assessment; no independent evaluation.

title: Nepal Floods and Landslides of September 2024: Updates 1 and 2
temporal_coverage: UNDP operational updates dated 15 November 2024 and 5 January 2025 after the September floods and landslides.
methodology: UNDP operational reporting on deployments and recovery activities.
limitations: Self-reported outputs and ongoing activities; no independent outcome assessment.
